elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 requires Vendor, on expiry or termination of the Agreement or an Order Form, to provide reasonable transition and migration assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 expressly provides assistance “for up to six months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Vendor's then-current rates.

elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires Vendor to return all Customer Data.

elements.element: The Customer Data return obligation must be triggered by expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 makes return conditional on Customer's request rather than automatically triggering it upon expiry or termination.

elements.element: Vendor must return Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The 30-day period runs from Customer's request, which may occur later than expiry or termination.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a standard format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires a complete, commonly used and documented format, satisfying the standard-format requirement.

elements.element: Customer Data must be returned in a machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 expressly requires a machine-readable format.

elements.element: Vendor must delete remaining Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 requires secure deletion after Customer confirms successful return, subject to backup cycling and legally required retention.

elements.element: Vendor must certify deletion after the data return and deletion.
elements.evidence: Section 11.3 requires an authorized officer to certify deletion in writing after successful return and deletion.

elements.element: Vendor must provide transition assistance upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.1 expressly provides post-expiry or post-termination transition and migration assistance at Customer's request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Assistance available for up to six months encompasses the requested 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Vendor must export or return Customer Data.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 requires return of all Customer Data in a usable machine-readable format.

elements.element: The data export obligation must be triggered by expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The operative export obligation is triggered only by Customer's request, not by expiry or termination itself.

elements.element: Vendor must export Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 11.2 measures the 30-day deadline from Customer's request, so export need not occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The redline correctly supplies up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, preserves the detailed data-return format, and retains written deletion certification. However, neither level is fully met because the operative 30-day data-return period runs from Customer's request rather than from expiry or termination. The drafting is internally coherent and resolves the immediate-deletion conflict, but it does not make the required timing changes needed to reach either complete position.
